entries.en: Introducing Claude Code for Desktop: https://claude.com/download
entries.zh: 推出 Claude Code 桌面版：https://claude.com/download

entries.en: Pro users can now purchase extra usage for access to Opus 4.5 in Claude Code
entries.zh: Pro 用户现在可以额外购买用量，以便在 Claude Code 中使用 Opus 4.5

entries.en: To give you room to try out our new model, we've updated usage limits for Claude Code users. See the Claude Opus 4.5 blog for full details
entries.zh: 为了让你试用新模型，我们调整了 Claude Code 用户的用量限额。详情请见 Claude Opus 4.5 博客

entries.en: Plan Mode now builds more precise plans and executes more thoroughly
entries.zh: 计划模式现在能制定更精确的计划，执行也更彻底

entries.en: Usage limit notifications now easier to understand
entries.zh: 用量限制通知的文字更容易理解
修正了思维错误的处理
